description: Loaned by British Airways to the people of Barbados after the 2003 Concorde retirement in recognition of the Barbados route's part in Concorde's commercial history; housed in a purpose-built hangar at Grantley Adams; the visitor attraction around it is closed but the hangar serves as the air-to-sea departure terminal in winter cruise season so the aircraft remains publicly seen; year_built left blank pending a sourced roll-out date
